'''Deravon Wells''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Talos Drellik]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] studied under Wells during Drellik's early career.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Talos Drellik}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Deravon Wells was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Talos Drellik in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
